newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Konstantinides wins 29 bln drs project.
newsitem.headline: Greek Konstantinides wins 29 bln drs project.

text.p: A consortium made up of Greek, Italian and Austrian construction firms was awarded a water purification project in northern Greece, budgeted at 29 billion drachmas, the ministry said in a statement on Friday.
The consortium is comprised of Konstantinides, Koronis SA, Secit Spa and Austrian Energy & Environment SGP/Wagner Biro.
Greek Public Works Minister Costas Laliotis ratified the result of the tender on Thursday, it said.
No further details as to the discount offered by the consortium and listed Konstantinides' participation were disclosed.
The project pertains to the first stage of construction of purification facilities for water supplied to Thessaloniki.
It will provide an alternative source of water supplies to the city, securing a flow of 150 thousand cubic meters on a daily basis projected to rise to 600 thousand by year 2030, the ministry said.
Konstantinides's shares shed 35 drachmas to 1,000 on Friday. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
